prompt:
Transform the attached comparison illustration into a MINIMAL BLACK INK ENGINEERING NOTEBOOK DRAWING. The previous engraving is rejected: remove ALL photorealistic volume, metallic reflections, dense crosshatching, food texture, ember glow, ground shadows, tonal shading and decorative detail. This must feel drawn with a fine technical pen on clean white paper, like a mechanical engineering student's elegant explanatory sketch, not an engraved product illustration and not a flat app icon.
Keep the technical comparison: LEFT direct charcoal heat with food above central coals; RIGHT indirect heat with two lateral coal baskets, no coals beneath the food, central drip tray. Two side-by-side sectional views of the same recognizable kettle grill, closed lid in operating position represented by a thin dome outline; interior visible because this is a SECTION, not a lid lifted open.
Use simplified front sectional elevations with just a slight axonometric hint in the grates. Thin black contours, two subtle line weights, sparse dashed centerlines and short light construction extensions. Walls in section can have 3 or 4 tiny diagonal hatch strokes ONLY. Large expanses of white inside and around the drawings. Legs reduced to simple structural lines; no wheel tread or hardware texture. Food shown as a SIMPLE BLACK OUTLINE of a rounded volume, no steak texture or red meat.
RED IS FOR INFORMATION ONLY: 2 very thin dark brick-red #7b251b heat-flow arrows on the left, 2 curved thin red arrows from the side coals up around food on the right. No filled arrows, no glowing coals, no red shading. Charcoal shown as a few clean irregular black outlined shapes.
Small neat technical uppercase lettering, exact Spanish text only:
over left drawing: "CALOR DIRECTO"
over right drawing: "CALOR INDIRECTO"
below left: "BRASAS BAJO EL ALIMENTO"
below right: "BRASAS A LOS LADOS"
one small common footer: "CORTE ESQUEMÁTICO · TAPA CERRADA"
No logo, no brand wordmark, no fake measurements, no numbers, no temperatures, no frames, no textures. Restrained publication-quality technical drawing with subtle hand-drafted character. Horizontal landscape composition 3:2, spacious and balanced. The recognizable apparatus and correct heat geometry matter; minimalist does not mean childish.
direction: Corrección explícita del usuario: dibujo técnico a tinta, minimalista blanco y negro con acentos rojos, apunte de ingeniería.
review: Ilustración revisada: carbón central bajo alimento en directo; carbón lateral separado de bandeja central en indirecto. Sin sombreado denso. Pendiente selección del usuario.
